subject: Re: Pricing request — competitive swap + migration incentives
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@payplus.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@payplus.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Request: competitive match + migration terms

Olga,

Following up from last week's briefing — PayPlus has received a formal proposal from CloudVector offering a 30% unit discount for the first 12 months, plus an onboarding credit of $120k and a 3-month free pilot (usage capped). Procurement asked whether Redwood can put forward a like-for-like counter so we can present options to the execs on Thursday.

Specifically we need:
- A clear per-token / per-embedding unit price that would match or beat CloudVector's 30% for year 1
- Any onboarding/migration credits or free pilot structure you can provide
- Commitment on SLA (p95 latency target and uptime) and any penalties/credits if missed
- Timeline for migration and whether you can support a parallel run for 30 days

Attached is the RFP summary (PayPlus_RFP_Q3.pdf). Can you get a preliminary counter by end of day Wednesday PT?

Thanks —
Liam O'Connor
Head of Procurement, PayPlus Inc.
liam.oconnor@payplus.com
+1 415 555 0128
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: competitive match + migration terms

Ben / Marissa — forwarding PayPlus's note. They want a like-for-like counter to CloudVector's 30% + $120k onboarding. They also called out a 3-month pilot and a parallel run.

Constraints: PayPlus is a mid-sized payments platform (high embedding usage for fraud/risk). We need to balance unit economics with a clean migration that reduces the friction. Can you sketch two options:

Option A (aggressive): match 30% off list for 12 months + $110k one-time migration credit + 45-day parallel run + 3 months of access to our dedicated onboarding team (SOW)
Option B (conservative): 20% off list, $60k migration credit, 60-day parallel run, extended SLA with 99.95% uptime clause and 30% service credit on breaches

Put numbers into a quick workbook and include the projected NRR impact for year 1. I told Liam we'll have a preliminary by EOD Wed.

Thanks —
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Request: competitive match + migration terms

Team — initial analysis attached (redwood_counter_offer.xlsx). High-level:

Option A (match aggressive):
- Year 1 effective unit price: 30% off list; assumes +20% usage uplift after migration
- One-time migration credit: $100k (we can stretch to $110k if we get a 24-month commit)
- Free pilot: 60-day pilot (we prefer 60 vs 90) with usage cap aligned to their avg Q3 usage
- SLA: 99.95% uptime, p95 latency target aligned to their observed 120ms target; service credits tiered (looks feasible)
- Estimated gross margin impact Y1: -18% vs baseline

Option B (protective):
- Year 1 effective unit price: 20% off list, stepdown to 10% in year 2
- Migration credit: $60k
- Parallel run: 60 days; dedicated migration engineer for first 30 days
- SLA: 99.9% uptime with 15% service credit on major incidents
- Estimated gross margin impact Y1: -8%

Recommendations and ask:
1) If we want to offer the full $110k credit we should secure a minimum 24-month committed ARR or a $1.2M annual spend threshold.
2) Approve DocuSign flow for quick amendment (Marissa — legal redlines?).
3) Include a one-time migration fee waiver only if customer signs the SOW for onboarding.

Attachments: redwood_counter_offer.xlsx (pricing model), migration-checklist.csv (high-level steps).

Ben Carter
Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: RE: Fwd: Request: competitive match + migration terms

Thanks Ben — I like Option A with conditional language to lock 24 months. A few tweaks before we send externally:

- Add a ramp incentive: first 90 days at matched 30% price, then gradual step to 20% for the remainder of Y1 if usage doesn't meet a 15% uplift threshold. This reduces exposure if uplift is lower than modeled.
- Offer an onboarding credit of $110k but structure it as: $60k upfront credit + $50k in implementation credits spread across the first two invoices contingent on milestone completion.
- SLA: include an elevated SLO addendum for enterprise customers for an extra fee; don't give the 99.95% guarantee without an ops runbook attachment.
- Approve DocuSign route — legal should prepare an amendment and a 24-month term sheet. Rishi, can you flag any margin floors we should not cross?

I'll draft the external email once we have final numbers.

Marissa Cole
Head of Commercial Deals | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@payplus.com>
Cc: procurement@payplus.com, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 3 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed counter: PayPlus migration + pricing incentive (summary)

Liam — thanks for the context and the RFP. Apologies for the thread length; below is a succinct counteroffer based on internal review.

Summary (high level)
- Pricing: match CloudVector's year-1 unit discount (30% off list) for the first 90 days; thereafter price steps to 20% for the remainder of year 1 unless usage uplift >= 15% vs baseline, in which case 30% continues for 12 months.
- Migration/onboarding: $110k total onboarding support structured as $60k upfront credit + $50k in implementation credits tied to checklist milestones (attached: migration-checklist.csv).
- Pilot/parallel run: 60-day parallel run with production traffic shadowing; full cutover plan included in the SOW.
- SLA: propose 99.95% uptime target for paid enterprise SLO addendum; operations runbook and incident escalation included as part of the onboarding SOW. Service credits tiered by incident severity.
- Commit: request a 24-month minimum commitment or a $1.2M ARR threshold to qualify for the full credit package.

Next steps
1) If the economics above look acceptable, we'll send a term amendment via DocuSign (link: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/ENVELOPE-998877) with the 24-month term and the pricing table.
2) We can schedule a technical migration kickoff the week of Apr 12th and allocate a senior migration engineer.
3) I'll attach the detailed pricing workbook for your review (redwood_counter_offer.xlsx) and the migration checklist.

Attachments: redwood_counter_offer.xlsx, migration-checklist.csv
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DEAL-1127

Please let me know if your execs need a variant (e.g., shorter commit with smaller credit). If you can confirm by Apr 7th we can lock resources for a mid-April start.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
